jobs.title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
jobs.description: Description BlueTuskr is a full-service e-commerce growth agency built exclusively for e-commerce brands. We combine paid media, owned media, creative, and analytics to help our clients scale profitably. Our team is made up of specialists who are deeply invested in their craft â and in the success of the brands they serve. This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well. The Opportunity We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands â emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative â and can explain exactly why each design choice was made. You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow â to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency. This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week, with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . Team Description The Brand Ad Formats team drives the development of ad formats that help advertisers maximize reach and brand impact. They focus on high-visibility, awareness-driven solutions that create memorable experiences for Reddit users. By delivering guaranteed placements and engaging ad interactions, they support major brand initiatives and help advertisers achieve measurable outcomes. The team is building fully customizable interactive formats and AI-driven ads that incorporate User-Generated Content (UGC). Moving forward, we will be doubling down on Video Ads, with the goal of turning Reddit into an industry leader and a ‘must buy’ for advertisers to promote video content. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. jobs.title: Front-End Developer
jobs.description: Headquarters: New York, NY URL: https://edconic.com/ Job Title: Front-End Developer Location: Fully Remote (US) Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales Reports to: Director of Web Development Classification: Regular, Full-time FLSA Status: Exempt Prepared by: Global Head of Creative Prepared Date: 10/1/26 Salary range: $85,000–$100,000 About Edconic Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals. The Role We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property – from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity. You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read. What You'll Do Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech. Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand. Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass. Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack. Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit. What You Bring 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress. The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields. Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript. Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line. A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO. Experience building and testing HTML emails. Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff. A proactive, self-directed working style – you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once. Excellent written and verbal communication – you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented. Bonus Experience Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns. Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions. Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing). CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement). Multilingual WordPress sites. A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue. UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite. How We Use AI AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same. AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process. Location, Travel & Eligibility Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required. Must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome. Our Commitment Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process. jobs.title: Web Developer: WordPress & HubSpot (U.S. Based, Remote Contractor)
jobs.description: Headquarters: Sarasota, FL URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/ SimpleTiger is hiring a part-time contract web developer to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role. We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly. As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch. Key responsibilities Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on) Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along Qualifications and skills You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working. Required skills WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one. HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates. Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site. APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack. Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues. Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t. Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack. Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision. Nice-to-have skills Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure. PHP development experience. Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients. Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices. Experience with Git and version control. What success looks like Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences. Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot. Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality. Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact. Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows. Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early. Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/simpletiger-web-developer-wordpress-hubspot-u-s-based-remote-contractor

Working closely with designers, marketers, writers, and project managers, you’ll create high-quality, on-brand assets across digital and print channels, turning creative direction into polished, effective visual communication. You’ll contribute ideas, collaborate across teams, and help deliver thoughtful, consistent design work from concept through to final production. What you’ll be doing: Design and produce high-quality creative assets across digital and print channels, including campaigns, presentations, sales tools, internal communications, social media, and landing pages. Translate creative direction into effective designs using strong layout, typography, colour, composition, and visual hierarchy. Contribute creative ideas and solutions that support brand identity and business objectives. Maintain brand consistency and ensure all deliverables meet quality standards and technical specifications. Prepare pixel-perfect, production-ready files for a range of platforms, formats, and audiences. Collaborate with designers, marketers, writers, and project managers to deliver creative projects. Manage tasks and deadlines, communicate progress, and proactively flag questions or potential challenges. Stay up to date with design trends, tools, and techniques to bring fresh ideas and inspiration to the team. What you need to bring: We're looking for a candidate who has experience with the following: Previous experience in graphic design or a related field, with a focus on digital design. A solid understanding of typography, layout, colour, composition, and visual hierarchy. Strong communication skills, with the confidence to ask questions, seek feedback, and proactively raise challenges. Strong written and spoken English skills. Availability to work European hours (4 pm–1 am PHT). Our hiring process is very straightforward. The whole process will be conducted at the comfort of your own home, through Zoom or Google Meet. No need to go through Manila's heavy traffic! Be a changemaker You’ll enjoy: Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day Work in a team large enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact Exposure to modern and proven technology Ability to work and grow in a truly flexible environment Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled: Market-leading salary package Permanent work from home setup Coworking space available, if needed We follow the PH holidays! jobs.description: RevenueCat removes the headaches of building and scaling in‑app subscriptions. Since graduating from YC’s S18 batch we’ve grown into the default monetization platform for mobile: we’re in >40% of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $12B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo dev in Brazil to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue. We’re a remote‑first crew of 150+, spread across 25+ countries, and guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. If you want your work to touch hundreds of millions of end‑users (and help the developers behind them get paid), you’ll fit right in. The Role We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead product strategy for our Funnels and Workflows products. We need a producty-engineer or an engineering-y product manager to lead the product vision in a highly technical, experimentation-driven domain where UX choices, growth tactics, and analytics all compound. RevenueCat is the monetization engine for 40% of the new subscription apps shipped. For most of those apps, Workflows and Funnels will be the products that actually do the monetizing: automating paywall decisions, running win-back and lifecycle campaigns, and turning web traffic into paying subscribers. We can, and should, be opinionated about what RevenueCat’s developers should try next to help them make more money . We’re building the “Make More Money Machine”. You'll lead two of RevenueCat's highest-leverage growth surfaces. Workflows will be the orchestration engine that lets developers trigger paywalls, win-back offers, and lifecycle campaigns based on real subscriber behavior. Funnels is our web2app product that turns web traffic into paying mobile subscribers, opening up an entirely new acquisition channel for our customers. You'll partner directly with leadership, collaborate across engineering and data teams, and act as the primary driver for how our customers convert, retain, and grow their subscriber base. What You'll Do Own the product strategy and roadmap for RevenueCat's new Workflows and Funnels products. Be obsessed with your customers. Speak to prospective customers to understand their use cases deeply, and identify the feature gaps blocking adoption. Coordinate with existing customers to unblock them and help them earn more money. Triage and investigate problems proactively, instead of fully delegating to engineering. Dig into what growth teams actually want and the challenges they face, and understand why these products are a crucial instrument in any modern app's growth toolkit. Recommend, develop, and maintain new features that deliver value that truly matters, enabling customers to easily spin up compelling experiences, understand the results, and iterate quickly. Set the vision. Create a plan that is cohesive, intentional, and impactful. Break it down into meaningful chunks on a reasonable timeline. Get it done. Collaborate closely with engineering, design, and GTM teams to bring these growth tools to market. This job cannot be done alone, and will require deep understanding of the individual products and the infrastructure that connects them. About you: You have 5+ years of product management or technical product engineering experience or analytics experience, with meaningful time growing mobile apps. You’re analytical. You can’t do your job without data platform access. You are highly proficient in SQL (or similar tools) — whatever tool you need to know, you’ll learn. You love getting deep on the data analysis on your own. You’re experienced in developing robust and scalable metrics. You are technical. Coding is not a core requirement for this role, being able to prototype with code is (using your preferred AI stack). You can deeply understand how RevenueCat works — what is simple and what is complex within our domain. Maybe you haven’t built and shipped a mobile app yourself (yet) but you have enough knowledge to work closely and independently with highly technical folks. You can discuss APIs, data models, and risk logic with engineering partners and enjoy diving into system details You’re an excellent communicator. You can express complex ideas clearly and succinctly — written and verbal, synchronous and asynchronous, across timezones and mediums. You can get your point across. What we offer: Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator 10-year window to exercise vested equity options Fully remote and flexible work environment 4-5 weeks of suggested time off annually for mental, physical, and emotional recharge $2,000 USD for workspace setup and $1,000 USD annual stipend for continuous learning Curious about the interview process? Discover more in our blog post about how we hire and learn tips to help you succeed.

jobs.title: Senior Graphic Designer
jobs.description: Headquarters: Hurst, TX URL: http://bbemarketing.com/ We’re looking for a creative, curious designer who can turn entertainment and sports industry data into compelling social content. You’ll come up with ideas, identify relevant news, create graphics, write captions, and check the information before it’s published. Our audience includes entertainment and sports professionals. We need someone who understands what would make these people stop, read, share, or join the conversation. What You’ll Do Generate original content ideas. Find interesting angles in our data and industry developments, including infographics, comparisons, agency breakdowns, rankings, and recurring series. Bring ideas proactively and experiment with new formats. Create the graphics yourself. Design clear, engaging infographics, carousels, and news graphics that communicate information effectively and look polished on social media. Choose the right news stories. Review incoming industry news and decide which stories matter to our audience, why they matter, and how we should present them. Write the copy. Create headlines, on-graphic text, hooks, and captions in clear, confident English suited to an industry-professional audience. Review researchers’ work. Check the data and supporting sources provided by our research team. Verify names, agency relationships, dates, totals, percentages, and other details. Flag inconsistencies and work with researchers to resolve them. Own the final quality check. Make sure the graphic and caption match the verified data, the headline is supported, and the finished post is accurate and easy to understand. Manage the content calendar. Balance planned content with timely responses to relevant industry news. Learn from performance. Review what resonates with our audience and use those insights to improve future content. What We’re Looking For A strong graphic design portfolio, especially infographics, editorial graphics, social media carousels, or other information-focused content. The ability to take a post from initial idea through design, caption writing, and final review. Strong creative and editorial judgment. You can look at a dataset or news story, identify an interesting angle, and explain why our audience would care. Excellent written English, including the ability to make complex information clear and concise. Strong attention to detail and comfort working with spreadsheets, checking percentages, and reviewing sources. Proficiency in the design tools needed to produce polished graphics and organized, editable files. Initiative and curiosity. You regularly bring forward ideas, explore possibilities, and improve concepts through feedback. Strong organization, reliable communication, and the ability to manage deadlines independently. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bbe-marketing-inc-senior-graphic-designer

Familiarity with Jira and Confluence a plus; Data informed problem solver having experience with A/B testing platforms and Google Analytics; Proactive and ability to work both independently and as an effective team member in a team environment; Interest in animal protection issues preferred. jobs.title: Web Frontend Engineer - JS, CSS, React, Flutter
jobs.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of globally distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Web/UI Engineer to develop a data-rich and reliable user experience. These frontends are constructed using JS, CSS, React, and Flutter, and serve as Canonical’s enterprise products that act as the company's face to our users. In order to create consistency across our products and sites, we have a central team that builds an open-source React toolkit and presentation layer, the Vanilla Framework . We are excited to develop this further and see if we can help more open-source projects build performant and accessible interfaces that respond well to diverse layouts. We use REST APIs for communication, and we consider API design an important part of the process. Flutter is a new front-end technology that has the potential to unify our desktop and web development. We are growing the team's exposure to Flutter and have roles on both web and Ubuntu engineering for this specialism. We hire developers with outstanding academic results and a passion for open-source software, innovation, and cutting-edge web technologies. In these roles, you will have the opportunity to make significant contributions through high-quality, front-end and back-end code while exhibiting technical leadership, exceptional design, and intuitive user experience. Additionally, we encourage colleagues to engage with the broader open-source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and ensure seamless software operations at scale. Location : This is a Globally remote role. The role entails Design and implement well-tested and documented software in Web technologies or Flutter. Debug and fix issues encountered by your users Participate in our engineering process through code and architectural reviews Collaborate with community and colleagues on technical specifications Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind Seek improvements to engineering and operations practices Deploy and operate services developed by the team Contribute to the success of your product through technical advocacy What we are looking for in you An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations Well-organised, self-starting and able to deliver to schedule Professional manner in interacting with colleagues, partners, and community Experience designing and writing high-quality Web technologies Experience with and passion for Typescript, React or Flutter An eye for accessibility and performance Professional written and spoken English Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred) Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation Excellent communication and presentation skills Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments Ability to travel twice a year, for company events for up to two weeks each Nice-to-have skills Experience with container tech such as LXD, Docker and Kubernetes Attention to detail concerning user-centric UI development REST API design, development and governance Performance engineering and security experience What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
